solutions.title: BFS bank scan
solutions.strategy: Run BFS and test each unused bank gene as the next mutation candidate.

timeComplexity.explanation: For up to B bank genes, each BFS layer may compare against unused genes of length L.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The queue and visited set can hold bank genes.

solutions.title: Generated-neighbor BFS
solutions.strategy: Generate all one-character mutations from each gene and keep only mutations present in the bank.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each reachable bank gene generates a constant alphabet of L positions.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The bank set, visited removals, and queue are linear in the number of bank genes.
